toolchain-preflight.description: Check Rocky Linux VCS, license, and Verilog conversion tool availability for de_coding.
arguments:
cd /mnt/e/Desktop/ic_de_dv/foundation/de_coding && printf 'Linux: ' && uname -r && printf '
VCS: ' && (command -v vcs || true) && vcs -ID && printf '
Make: ' && command -v make && printf '
License: %s
' "${SNPSLMD_LICENSE_FILE:-unset}"

vcs-all.description: Run every generated per-module Verilog-2005 smoke test in Rocky Linux with VCS and save a summary.

vcs-retry-failures.description: Retry modules marked failed in the saved VCS summary and update their results.

vcs-makefile-check.description: Check plain Makefile targets for the sync FIFO and priority encoder using VCS.
arguments: cd /mnt/e/Desktop/ic_de_dv/foundation/de_coding/04_memory_and_interfaces/sync_fifo && make test_sync_fifo && make clean && cd /mnt/e/Desktop/ic_de_dv/foundation/de_coding/01_combinational_logic/priority_encoder && make test_prio_encoder && make test_tb_prio_encoder && make clean

vcs-counters.description: Run self-checking VCS testbenches for up, down, and mod-N counters, then clean generated build files.
arguments: cd /mnt/e/Desktop/ic_de_dv/foundation/de_coding/02_sequential_logic/counters && make test; status=$?; cd /mnt/e/Desktop/ic_de_dv/foundation/de_coding/02_sequential_logic/counters && make clean; clean_status=$?; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; else exit $clean_status; fi

vcs-nm6008-matrix.description: Run the NM6008 two-term matrix-vector multiplier testbench with VCS and clean generated files.
arguments: cd /mnt/e/Desktop/ic_de_dv/foundation/de_coding/07_arithmetic_and_datapath/nm6008_matrix_multiplier && make test_MatrixMultiplier_tb; status=$?; cd /mnt/e/Desktop/ic_de_dv/foundation/de_coding/07_arithmetic_and_datapath/nm6008_matrix_multiplier && make clean; clean_status=$?; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; else exit $clean_status; fi

vcs-missing-code-suite.description: Run VCS self-checking testbenches for the newly implemented missing exam exercises, then clean every exercise build directory.

vcs-test2.description: Compile and run all Test2 Verilog testbenches using VCS in isolated temporary directories.

vcs-sv.description: Compile and run all non-UVM SystemVerilog source variants against sibling testbenches in isolated temporary directories.

vcs-uvm.description: Run and clean the adders_uvm VCS/UVM regression, requiring 8 passes and no UVM errors.
arguments: cd /mnt/e/Desktop/ic_de_dv/foundation/de_coding/01_combinational_logic/adders_uvm && make run; status=$?; if [ $status -eq 0 ] && grep -q 'PASS=8 FAIL=0' sim.log && ! grep -Eq '^UVM_(ERROR|FATAL)[[:space:]]+[^:]|^UVM_(ERROR|FATAL)[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[1-9]' sim.log; then result=0; else result=1; fi; grep -E 'UVM_(ERROR|FATAL)|SB_REPORT' sim.log 2>/dev/null || true; make clean; clean_status=$?; if [ $result -ne 0 ]; then exit $result; else exit $clean_status; fi

vcs-secretcode.description: Run the secret-code assignment scan and legacy secretcode self-checking regressions in isolated temporary directories.

eda-tools-preflight.description: Check whether the course Design Vision/DC and Innovus executables are available in Rocky Linux.
arguments: for tool in dc_shell-xg-t design_vision innovus; do command -v $tool || echo $tool: unavailable; done
